'''Kvarn Mandel''' was the head of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech, Inc.]], an important manufacturer of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and control systems for [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Mandel was an aristocrat who was a strong supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], as well as being a devoted family man.

Kvarn Mandel customarily dressed in fancy clothes, such as flowing capes, and wore his hair in a long pony tail. With his mustache and goatee, he had the appearance of a stately gentleman. While he possessed the ruthlessness required to run such a powerful corporation, Mandel was generally courteous when dealing with others.

While he regularly traveled to the Fabritech headquarters for his work, Mandel made sure to spend some time each month at home with his family. For Kvarn Mandel, his [[Emlyn Mandel|wife]], and his four children, home was the [[Mandel family mansion]] in the underground [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fabrin (city)|Fabrin]] on [[Thorgeld I]].

The biggest tragedy in Mandel's life was the disappearance of his youngest daughter, [[Samire Mandel|Samire]], at the age of sixteen. Although there was no proof, by the time eleven years had passed, Mandel had convinced himself that his daughter was dead. This was a source of conflict between Mandel and his youngest son, [[Simmin Mandel|Simmin]], who continued to search for his sister, even going so far as to hire the [[Skine Bounty Hunter College]] to try to find her.

Mandel opposed this continued search partly because of his belief that Samire had been killed, and partly because he worried that rather than being dead, she may have joined an organization affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As Kvarn Mandel owed much of the success of Fabritech, as well as his own personal success, to the Empire, this possibility disturbed him.
